§6DNT Nano Suit§f

§aThe apex armor. Perfect protection, 1 GHE per piece, requires nearly everything to craft.§f

The DNT Nano Suit is the strongest armor in the mod. It offers 100% protection against all damage types except explosions (which it blocks 99% of). Full set bonuses include strength, haste, jump boost, rocket boots, boosted sprint, and enemy HUD.

§6Crafting§f: Requires a full §bLunar Cybernetic Armor§f set (consumed), §e24§f DNT compound plates (from dineutronium compound plates in an anvil), a spark singularity (helmet), the Balls-O-Tron coin (leggings), and a closed demon core (boots). That's a particle accelerator, a boss kill, and lunar satellites just for ingredients.

§6Power§f: Each piece holds §e1 GHE§f and charges at 1 MHE/t. You need massive energy storage, the FEnSU, to keep this thing running.

§cWARNING:§f 1 GHE per piece is enormous. Without power, no protection. The FEnSU is mandatory before you attempt this armor.

§ePS:§f This is the absolute last thing you craft. Every other endgame project feeds into it.
